travel_danger_events.4010.entry: Own trigger requires at least2 eligible entourage characters age>=5, excluding root, travel_danger_recently_ill and existing illness. No location danger-type restriction; event cooldown3months. Travel OA weight100.
travel_danger_events.4010.immediate: MP-only90day delay helper. Select eligible entourage (adult weight base1+5), set that NPC travel_danger_recently_ill12months, invoke contract_disease_effect(ill,TREATMENT_EVENT=no), save ill_character. Helper also saves sick_character and disease_type. Prefer eligible entourage court physician excluding root/NPC; otherwise the outer fallback requires some eligible Learning>15 character, then preferentially selects lifestyle_physician else Learning>15, saving medical_character/medicine_person. Save next destination province.
travel_danger_events.4010.after: MP-only resume helper. Add root had_travel_danger_event_4010_recently for1year only if absent; does not refresh an already present flag. This flag is separate from the3month event cooldown.
